text: The author’s motive to integrate her fascination with history and the lessons it holds drives the thematic structure of continuity and change. By constructing a narrative around archaeologists uncovering an ancient civilization, she uses the physical act of digging into the past to symbolize how historical remnants actively shape the present and future. This structural choice reinforces the theme that time is not linear but cyclical, where the past continuously influences current realities, thereby illustrating the enduring power of history.
